**Case Mix**: The caseload now includes **51 FIRs** (2026) across diverse legal frameworks, such as cybercrimes (PECA 2016), narcotics (CNSA 1997), domestic violence, and property crimes, compared to 13 FIRs in 2024 focused on arms-related and robbery/conspiracy cases [Document 2].  

**Arrests**: Only **11 FIRs** (out of 73 total) record at least one arrest, while **62 FIRs** have no arrests [Document 3].  

**Reporting Delays**: The mean time from incident to report is **1401.3 minutes (~23.4 hours)** in 2026, significantly slower than **15.0 minutes** in 2024 [Document 4].  

**Weapon Licensing**: Of **32 weapon-register entries**, **30 recovered weapons** have **no licence recorded**, and **2 entries** lack licence status entirely [Document 5].

**Court Progress**: Of **33 criminal records**, **32 are still in progress**, and only **1 case** has reached a verdict [Document 8].
